D5/S3/ContinuousObservables/LaurentLoopF.name: D5.S3.ContinuousObservables.LaurentLoopFactorization.haah_factorization
D5/S3/ContinuousObservables/LaurentLoopF.signature: theorem haah_factorization : (∀ Ps : List M₂, (∀ P ∈ Ps, RankOneProjector P) → InClass Ps.length (Ps.map primitive).prod) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : ℤ →₀ M₂), (∀ j : ℤ, (n : ℤ) < |j| ∨ j % 2 ≠ (n : ℤ) % 2 → C j = 0) → (C n ≠ 0 ∨ C (-(n : ℤ)) ≠ 0) → CircleSU (ofCoefficients C) → ∃! r : M₂ × List M₂, Factorization n (ofCoefficients C) r
